summary: Backend testing for intent_detection.py. Found and fixed a critical bug: INTENT_PROMPT used str.format() but contained unescaped JSON template braces {}, causing silent KeyError and all GPT calls returning score=0. Fixed by escaping to {{}}. All 14 tests pass after fix.

critical.issue: INTENT_PROMPT JSON template braces {} not escaped for str.format() — caused KeyError silently caught, all real GPT calls returned score=0 instead of actual intent score

action_items: FIXED: Escaped JSON template braces in INTENT_PROMPT ({{ and }}) so str.format() works correctly — GPT now returns real scores
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: INTENT_PROMPT in intent_detection.py had unescaped curly braces in the JSON example. str.format() tried to interpret them as placeholders, throwing KeyError that was silently caught, returning default score=0 for all non-skip messages.

Note: GPT scored 'What are my monthly payments?' at 5 (not 7+) without conversation context — this is expected LLM variability with minimal context. With real conversation context (recent_messages), score will likely be higher.
process_inbound_intent push notification: import is inside try/except so push failure won't break intent storage — good defensive pattern
context_for_next_testing_agent: intent_detection.py bug fixed: INTENT_PROMPT JSON braces escaped. All 14 tests pass. detect_buying_intent: skip phrases return score=0, GPT integration working. process_inbound_intent: score<4 skips DB write, score 4-6 sets intent_score+hot_opportunity=False, score>=7 sets hot_opportunity=True. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_intent_detection.py
rca_of_issue: Root cause: INTENT_PROMPT string contained a JSON example block with raw {score}, {signals} etc. that str.format() interpreted as replacement field names. Python raised KeyError which was caught by the broad except block, returning the default {score:0} response. Fix: escape all non-placeholder braces in the template to {{ and }}.
